review_candidates.description: Job Description Business Overview The Technology Platforms Division (TPD) drives the growth of Rakuten's ecosystem by delivering innovative, high-quality technology platforms characterized by integrated control and strategic partnerships. Within TPD, the Cloud Platform Supervisory Department (CPSD) develops and manages Rakuten's state-of-the-art cloud platform, empowering global scalability and accelerating innovation across its diverse business units. Department Overview The Cloud Platform Enablement Department (CPED) drives Rakuten Group's global infrastructure strategy by building and operating a robust private cloud platform and supporting public cloud environments. We empower application engineers to build reliable and scalable systems while ensuring unified support and consistent quality across all departments. The Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) is a cross-functional team responsible for creating and implementing cloud-related best practices, guidelines, and governance policies. Our primary mission is to ensure that cloud resources are used effectively and efficiently to achieve Rakuten's business objectives. We drive our multi-cloud strategy across GCP, AWS, Azure, and OCI, accelerating cloud adoption, enhancing security, standardizing processes, fostering faster innovation, and optimizing cost efficiency (FinOps) throughout the organization. Position Why We Hire As public cloud adoption continues to grow across the organization, we need dedicated cloud engineers to handle the increasing volume of cloud requests, configuration tasks, and user inquiries. We are looking for an engineer who can take ownership of day-to-day cloud operations and grow as a core member of the team, enabling existing members to focus on higher-level architecture and governance work. Position Details You will be responsible for day-to-day cloud operations across our multi-cloud environment (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), while also collaborating with internal teams and vendors, driving improvements to existing cloud environments, and contributing to team knowledge management. Key Responsibilities Cloud Governance Improvement Periodically review and propose improvements to governance policies, security guardrails, and operational rules Update and promote best practices based on analysis of organization-wide cloud usage trends Propose and implement automation and efficiency improvements for CCoE operations (including scripting and tooling) Analyze recurring issues Execute operations based on existing runbooks and manuals Conduct pre/post-checks, document results, and report outcomes in Jira tickets Troubleshoot issues encountered during operations and escalate when necessary Support & Inquiry Handling Provide first-line responses to technical inquiries from internal cloud users Answer and guide users referencing existing FAQs and documentation Escalate runbooks on Confluence Accumulate and organize operation records and team knowledge Periodically review and update existing documentation Propose process improvements and contribute to operational cases with cloud vendors (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, etc.) Participate in regular vendor meetings, gather information on new services, and share relevant updates internally Drive smooth cross-team communication in group-wide cloud initiatives Work Environment You will work as part of a 12-member team, collaborating with global members. English is the primary language of communication and is used in all daily meetings, Slack interactions, and documentation . Mandatory Qualifications More than 3 years of hands-on experience operating and configuring public cloud environments (2 or more of AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI) Experience with basic IAM and networking configuration (VPC, subnets, security groups, etc.) Experience working with Jira or equivalent ticket management tools Ability to execute tasks accurately based on runbooks and manuals Basic troubleshooting skills (log analysis, root cause isolation, etc.) Business-level English communication skills (meetings, Slack, documentation) Desired Qualifications Hands-on experience with multiple cloud platforms (2 or more) Associate-level or above cloud certification from AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI Experience creating documentation using Confluence Basic experience with IaC tools such as Terraform Experience with cloud operations that consider security and compliance requirements Experience in internal user support or helpdesk roles Experience proposing and driving process improvements or standardization Experience leveraging AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude Code) to improve work efficiency Other Information Additional information on English Qualification TOEIC Score 800 above or possess equivalent abilities #engineer #infrastructureengineer #technologyplatformdiv Languages English (Overall - 3 - Advanced), Japanese (Overall - 2 - Intermediate)

review_candidates.description: Staples Promotional Products (SPP) supports a broad portfolio of internal and customer-facing applications used to manage promotional product operations, B2B capabilities, order flow, integrations, reporting, and supporting business processes. The SPP technology team partners with development, QA, infrastructure, security, business support, and product stakeholders to deliver reliable application changes and support the ongoing modernization of delivery practices. This role strengthens the DevOps engineering capability for SPP by adding a hands-on engineer focused on Azure DevOps pipeline ownership, Octopus Deploy support, TFS workflow support, GitHub readiness, Azure cloud enablement, CI/CD standardization, deployment automation, DevSecOps enablement, reusable engineering patterns, and technical delivery maturity across the SPP application portfolio. We are seeking a talented Senior DevOps Engineer to support the Staples Promotional Products application portfolio. This hands-on engineering role will focus on owning and improving CI/CD capabilities, standardizing Azure DevOps pipeline practices, supporting Octopus Deploy and TFS delivery workflows, preparing for future GitHub adoption, improving build and deployment automation, supporting DevSecOps integration, and building practical Azure cloud delivery capabilities for future modernization. The role is intended for an engineer who can work independently from the GCC location while collaborating with CST-based SPP stakeholders during available overlap hours. The engineer will not own release governance, release scheduling, release communications, or DevOps management responsibilities; those responsibilities remain with the DevOps Manager. Instead, this role provides the engineering execution layer for pipeline reliability, deployment automation, source control modernization, and DevOps platform maturity. Duties & Responsibilities: · Build, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve CI/CD pipelines, with emphasis on Azure DevOps pipeline ownership, reusable templates, consistent YAML patterns, and standardized engineering practices across SPP applications. · Support and improve Octopus Deploy projects, deployment channels, deployment variables, package promotion patterns, release pipeline integrations, and deployment automation reliability. · Support legacy TFS workflows where still required, including build/release definitions, source control integration, artifact feeds, work item linkage, and migration-readiness activities. · Prepare SPP for future GitHub adoption by supporting GitHub Enterprise readiness, repository modernization, branching strategy alignment, pull request workflows, and GitHub Actions evaluation where appropriate. · Partner with development and infrastructure teams when new pipelines or deployment automation changes are needed, reducing dependency on application developers for long-term pipeline ownership. · Create reusable pipeline patterns, build templates, release templates, deployment automation approaches, and technical standards that improve consistency across Azure DevOps, Octopus, TFS, and future GitHub-based workflows. · Support Azure platform enablement by developing working familiarity with Azure services, Azure resource management, identity and access concepts, cloud application delivery patterns, and Azure-native automation opportunities. · Troubleshoot build failures, deployment failures, Octopus package/deployment issues, TFS integration issues, source control integration issues, pipeline agent issues, artifact publishing concerns, and environment-related pipeline blockers. · Partner with infrastructure teams on pipeline dependencies, deployment automation, permissions, secret management, service connections, agent pools, Octopus variables, Azure resource access, and environment configuration needs. · Support DevSecOps enablement by helping integrate security scanning, dependency review, vulnerability follow-up, and compliance checks into CI/CD workflows where appropriate. · Identify repetitive pipeline, deployment-support, build-validation, and operational engineering tasks that can be automated through scripts, templates, workflow tooling, or Azure-native automation. · Create and maintain technical documentation for pipeline design, Octopus deployment automation, TFS workflows, GitHub readiness, Azure DevOps standards, source control expectations, DevSecOps integration, and troubleshooting procedures. Requirements Basic Qualifications: · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. · 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps Engineering, CI/CD Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Technical Operations, or related field. · Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving CI/CD pipelines. · Proficiency with Azure DevOps including Pipelines, Repositories, YAML-based automation, build/release automation, repository integration, and deployment workflow support. · Experience with Octopus Deploy or comparable enterprise deployment automation platforms. · Experience working with TFS or legacy Microsoft ALM workflows, including build/release definitions, source control integration, artifact feeds, or migration-support activities. · Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based application delivery practices. · Strong understanding of Git-based source control practices, branching concepts, pull request workflows, and release/deployment integration. · Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Shell, YAML, or similar technologies. · Experience troubleshooting build failures, deployment failures, pipeline agent issues, Octopus deployment issues, artifact publishing concerns, source control issues, and environment-related pipeline blockers. · Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to address complex pipeline, deployment automation, DevSecOps, source control, Azure, and platform delivery issues. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders. · Proven ability to work independently, manage technical tasks across time zones, produce clear handoff documentation, and collaborate with GCC and CST-based teams. Preferred Qualifications: · Experience migrating or modernizing legacy TFS processes to Azure DevOps or GitHub. · Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, repository governance, branching strategy modernization, or source control migration initiatives. · Experience with Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Azure Automation, or related Azure services. · Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. · Exposure to DevSecOps practices including Checkmarx, SonarQube, dependency scanning, vulnerability remediation tracking, certificate monitoring, or security scan integration. · Experience creating reusable pipeline templates, Octopus deployment automation patterns, technical standards, or developer enablement documentation. · Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, FluxCD, Kustomize, or related container/platform technologies. · Interest or experience with AI technologies to automate engineering workflows, system management, documentation, and operational analysis.
